note: Identifiers only. Remake freestanding rupees and recovery hearts: placed Obj_Rupee and Obj_Heart actors with a permanent row (reset type 24) whose hash no other catalog row holds. One row per actor hash, so the adult and the child copy of a spot are two rows. Names are made up for this tool and never change, Archipelago reads them. item is the placed actor, vanilla its item. region and rule are chosen like data/pots_remake.json revision 2: every region the data offers (OoTR candidates of the remake research, the tracker guess, the known checks within 20 units in the same layer), the HARDER one at the age of the spot, and the baseline rule (the age only) unless every OoTR candidate agrees on one region and rule. Left out: the Zora diving game rupees, actors with a Presence flag, and spots with no known check nearby. They join the shuffle with shuffle_freestanding_items set to all and hold any item.
